testCase.name: CertificateService Duration Calculation should correctly calculate "2 years, 1 month" for June 7 2024 to July 9 2026
CertificateService Duration Calculation should correctly calculate "1 year" for exactly 12 months
CertificateService Duration Calculation should correctly calculate "6 months" within the same year
CertificateService Token Normalization & Hashing should normalize uppercase, trim whitespace, and strip NCH- prefix
CertificateService Token Normalization & Hashing should calculate accurate 64-char SHA-256 hex string
CertificateService Public Verification should throw BadRequestException if token format is invalid
CertificateService Public Verification should throw NotFoundException if token does not exist in database
CertificateService Public Verification should return valid certificate response when active record exists
CertificateService Public Verification should return REVOKED status if certificate was revoked
CertificateService Rate Limiting should allow up to 10 verification requests within 1 minute from the same IP, then block the 11th
CertificateService Certificate Generation should create volunteer if not provided, hash token, and return raw token once
CertificateService Certificate Generation should email the verification code to the volunteer when an email is provided
